description: This file defines the main CLI root command for the AgentField platform, configuring flags, commands, and initialization logic using the Cobra library. It provides setup for version information, configuration loading, and subcommands for server operation and various framework commands.

methods.name: NewRootCommand
methods.description: Creates and configures the main Cobra command for the CLI, setting up flags, subcommands, and version info handling.

methods.name: initConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from file or environment variables, setting up Viper accordingly.

methods.name: GetConfigFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the configuration file specified by the user.

methods.name: GetOpenBrowserFlag
methods.description: Returns whether the open browser flag is enabled.

methods.name: GetUIDevFlag
methods.description: Returns whether the UI development server flag is enabled.

methods.name: GetBackendOnlyFlag
methods.description: Returns whether to run only backend APIs without UI.

methods.name: GetPortFlag
methods.description: Returns the port number specified for the server.
